note: Reduced artefact. The live /docs response is the static spec banked as openapi-v2.json with the serverId enums and descriptions injected per request; only those injected parts plus a structural fingerprint are recorded here. VERIFIED 2026-08-25 by a full recursive diff of the live body against openapi-v2.json inside the container: exactly 8 differences, all four serverId parameters gaining an enum plus a rewritten description, and nothing else. Contrary to the earlier reading of the handler source, the live response carries NO servers[] key at all - it is absent from both documents. The sha256 below is over the live document with servers[] popped and the serverId enums/descriptions stripped; the same computation over openapi-v2.json in the same interpreter yields the same digest. Compute it with UTF-8 decoding - the file has 15 non-ASCII bytes and a locale-default open() on Windows produces a different digest.
